Breaking changes: * Removed dependencies on `tobibeer/appear` and `ooktech/dynamic-tables` * Requires TiddlyWiki 5.2.0 or later * Simplified configuration options Technical improvements: * Replaced widget hijacking with lightweight startup module * Uses standard Reveal widget and PageTemplate * Integrated with TiddlyWiki palette system for theme compatibility * Modern CSS with backdrop-filter glass effect and smooth animations * Document-level event delegation for better performance * 150ms hover delay to avoid accidental triggers File changes: * Added: `startup.js`, `page-template.tid`, `palette-styles.tid` * Modified: all style and template files * Removed: `link.js`, `keyboard.js`, `popups.tid` Migration: Upgrading from 0.6.0 should work automatically. About Link hover preview plugin with glass effect. Complete rewrite of [[tobibeer/preview|https://tobibeer.github.io/tw5-plugins/#preview]]. Shows popup on link hover with: * Content excerpt (first few lines) * Optional rendered body preview * Backlinks (requires inverse-link-and-folder plugin) * Metadata (modified, created, tags) !! Features * Glass effect with backdrop-filter * Adapts to all themes via TiddlyWiki palette system * Lightweight implementation using document-level event listeners * Positioned near cursor * Configurable exclusions for system/shadow tiddlers * 150ms hover delay to avoid accidental triggers * Supports lazy-loaded and metadata-only tiddlers * Can stay open while hovering the popup and follow links inside it !! Optional Dependencies * [[$:/plugins/linonetwo/inverse-link-and-folder]] - for displaying backlinks !! Configuration Visit the [[config panel|$:/plugins/linonetwo/preview-glass/config]] to customize: * Preview content template * Whether to keep the popup open while hovering it * Whether to show the body excerpt * Whether the body is rendered as wikitext * Exclusion rules (system/shadow tiddlers) !! Implementation |!Component |!Description | |`startup.ts` |Document-level event listener | |`page-template.tid` |Popup display using Reveal widget | |`template.tid` |Customizable preview content template | |`palette-styles.tid` |Palette-based color styles | |`preview-template.css` |Structural CSS | !! Comparison |!Aspect |!v0.6.0 |!v1.0.0 | |Implementation |Hijacks link widget |startup module + PageTemplate | |Dependencies |tobibeer/appear, dynamic-tables |None (inverse-link optional) | |Performance |Hijacks every link render |Event delegation | |Styling |Hardcoded colors |Palette system | |Maintainability |Complex JS |Clean TS + standard APIs | !! Changelog See [[changelog|$:/plugins/linonetwo/preview-glass/changelog]] for version history. !!
